items.claim: Islam Makhachev is a fantastic wrestler.
items.quote: Islam Makhachev's going to be a fantastic wrestler like he always is.

items.claim: Islam Makhachev has the advantage if he can put Ian Garry on the fence or his back.
items.quote: I think that Islam can make this happen the easiest by putting Ian Garry on the fence.

items.claim: Ian Garry has the advantage on the feet in free-flowing movement.
items.quote: Ian Garry has the advantage on the feet in the free-flowing movement.

items.claim: Ian Garry uses a front knee kick to keep space and has good balance without overextending, preventing takedowns.
items.quote: he does do a good job with that knee kick, that front knee kick that he does to keep the space... he's really balanced. He never overextends.

items.claim: Ian Garry has a considerable size and height advantage over Islam Makhachev.
Ian Garry has a big, long reach that Makhachev will have to navigate.
items.quote: Ian Garry has a big long reach that Makhachev is going to have to look
